svg.aria-label: One continuous animation of an app window, with a server log on the left and the database on the right. A command for the numbers 4, 8 and 15 is saved with its message in one transaction. kill -9 ends the process and the log goes dark, while both database rows stay. After a restart, two delivery attempts fail while the receiver is down. The third lands, the message is marked delivered and one receipt prints: count 3, sum 27, minimum 4, maximum 15. Write the backend once. Keep the work when the process dies.
